project_summary: Single-page React 19 questionnaire app for collecting brand design briefs. 7-step wizard with localStorage draft persistence. No database. One serverless function sends the completed brief via SMTP email to a hardcoded recipient. Entire frontend lives in a single 1665-line App.tsx. UI is in Ukrainian. Deployed on Vercel.

tech_stack.name: Tailwind CSS 4
tech_stack.role: Utility-first CSS, v4 CSS-first config (no tailwind.config.js)

tech_stack.name: nodemailer 8
tech_stack.role: SMTP email sending in serverless function

tech_stack.name: Vercel
tech_stack.role: Hosting: static CDN for frontend + serverless for api/

architecture_layers.name: Frontend
architecture_layers.description: Entire React application. All types, state, components, and validation co-located in App.tsx. No component library — everything custom-built with Tailwind.

architecture_layers.name: Backend (Serverless)
architecture_layers.description: Single Vercel serverless function. POST-only. Validates env vars, builds nodemailer transporter, sends brief as .json + .txt email attachments.

architecture_layers.name: Config
architecture_layers.description: Build tooling, runtime config, environment variable documentation.

architecture_layers.name: External Services
architecture_layers.description: SMTP server (any provider via env vars). No other external services. No CDN, no analytics, no monitoring.

architecture_layers.name: Data Layer (Client)
architecture_layers.description: localStorage only. Key: brand-brief-questionnaire-draft. Stores full BrandBrief as JSON. No server-side persistence.

main_modules.name: BrandBrief type
main_modules.description: Core TypeScript type defining all 7 sections of the brief. Includes nested types for Competitor. This is the canonical data model.
fields: companyBasics: { brandName, links, description, category, geography, stage }
brandEssence: { whatCompanyDoes, problemSolved, whyChoose, brandWords[], promise, desiredFeeling }
targetAudience: { audience, ageRange, lifestyle, needs, fears, choiceFactors }
visualDirection: { logoType, mood: Record<string,number>, preferredColors, forbiddenColors, typography, references, uploadedReferences[], clichesToAvoid }
practicalUsage: { placements[], darkLightVersions, smallSizeReadability, printReadyFiles, futureAnimation }
scopeAndDeliverables: { deliverables[], deadline, budget, decisionMakers, comments }

main_modules.name: State management
main_modules.description: Single useState<BrandBrief>. Deep-merge update pattern via field setter. useEffect syncs to localStorage on every change. useMemo used for derived values.
main_modules.note: No external state library (no Redux, Zustand, etc.)

main_modules.name: Step validation
main_modules.description: validateStep(step: number): string[] — returns array of Ukrainian error messages. Called on Next button click. Blocks navigation if errors exist.

main_modules.name: UI Primitives
main_modules.description: Custom component library defined inline. All built with Tailwind classes. No separate component files.
components: TextInput — labeled input with error state
FileUpload — drag/drop or click, stores as base64
Stepper — step indicator with click navigation

main_modules.name: Step Components (×7)
main_modules.description: One component per wizard step. Each receives brief state + setter as props. All defined in App.tsx after primitives.

main_modules.name: SummaryPage
main_modules.description: Final view before submission. Renders all brief sections. Buttons: Copy JSON, Download JSON, Download TXT, Submit. Submit POSTs to /api/send-brief.

main_modules.name: send-brief serverless function
main_modules.description: Vercel serverless handler. Validates SMTP env vars → creates transporter → builds email with two attachments (brief.json, brief.txt) → sends to hardcoded recipient v.demidov@urc.org.ua.

response_codes.400: Invalid brief object in request body
response_codes.500: Missing SMTP env vars or nodemailer error

data_flow.name: App load
data_flow.description: React mounts. useEffect reads localStorage key brand-brief-questionnaire-draft. If valid JSON found, sets as initial BrandBrief state.

data_flow.name: User input
data_flow.description: Field changes call setter with deep merge. useEffect detects state change and serializes full BrandBrief to localStorage.

data_flow.name: Step navigation
data_flow.description: Next button calls validateStep(currentStep). If errors.length > 0, sets error state and blocks. If 0 errors, increments currentStep.

data_flow.name: Summary review
data_flow.description: User reaches step 8 (summary). Can click any step dot to return and edit. Can download brief locally without submitting.

data_flow.name: Submission
data_flow.description: User clicks Submit. fetch POST to /api/send-brief with JSON body { brief: BrandBrief }. Shows loading state.

data_flow.name: Server processing
data_flow.description: Serverless function receives body, validates SMTP env vars, creates transporter, builds .json and .txt attachments, sends email via SMTP.

data_flow.name: Result feedback
data_flow.description: Client receives 200 (success) or error code. Displays success or error message inline. No state reset — localStorage draft remains.

api_routes.side_effects: Sends email to v.demidov@urc.org.ua with brief.json and brief.txt attachments

external_services.name: SMTP Server
external_services.configured_via: env vars: SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM
external_services.note: No specific provider locked in. Works with SendGrid, Gmail, Mailgun, etc.

entry_points.description: HTML shell. Loads src/main.tsx via Vite. Mounts React into #root div.
React StrictMode wrapper. Renders <App /> into document.getElementById('root').
Default export is Vercel serverless handler function. POST /api/send-brief.

critical_files.note: Contains everything: types, state, validation, all components, all steps, submission. Single point of failure.
Only backend logic. All email sending here. Recipient hardcoded.
Registers serverless function. Wrong config here breaks /api routes.
Documents all required SMTP env vars. Actual .env not committed.
Global CSS reset, color variables, font. Tailwind import.
dev:vercel script needed for local full-stack dev with serverless.

how_to_add_features: 1. Read src/App.tsx top-to-bottom before changing anything — all types, components, and logic are inline.

2. To add a new form field: (a) extend BrandBrief type, (b) add to initialBriefState, (c) add UI in the relevant StepComponent, (d) add validation in validateStep() if required, (e) add rendering in SummaryPage.
3. To add a new wizard step: add StepComponent, increment totalSteps, add case in validateStep, add render in SummaryPage, add section in the step renderer switch.
4. To change the email recipient: find hardcoded string 'v.demidov@urc.org.ua' in api/send-brief.ts and replace with process.env.SMTP_TO — also add to .env.example.

5. To extract components: create src/components/ directory, move component definition (copy exact function signature and props), export, import in App.tsx. Avoid prop drilling — pass the full brief section as a prop.
6. All UI text is in Ukrainian — maintain consistency when adding new labels, error messages, or option values.
where_to_look_first: src/App.tsx — for any frontend logic (types, validation, state, components)
vercel.json — for deployment and routing issues
src/index.css — for global style variables and font config
what_to_avoid: Do not add more logic to App.tsx without extracting — it is already a monolith at 1665 lines.
Do not store large files (images) in localStorage — it will hit the 5MB quota.
Do not change BrandBrief type shape without handling existing localStorage drafts (add a schema version check or migration).
Do not trust uploaded files to arrive at the server — FileUpload only stores base64 in state, it is NOT sent via the API.
Do not deploy without setting all 5 SMTP env vars in Vercel dashboard — the function returns 500 if any are missing.
Do not add client-side auth — the app is intentionally anonymous. If auth is needed, handle it server-side.
Do not use Tailwind v3 syntax — the project uses Tailwind v4 which has breaking changes (no tailwind.config.js, different color syntax).
coding_conventions: TypeScript strict mode is on — no implicit any, no non-null assertions without justification.
Components use inline Tailwind classes — no CSS modules, no styled-components.
All user-facing strings are in Ukrainian.
State updates use deep merge pattern via the field setter — never mutate nested objects directly.
Serverless function validates all env vars at startup — fail fast with 500 rather than partial execution.
Tailwind v4 is CSS-first — theme customization goes in src/index.css using @theme, not in a config file.
ESLint flat config format (eslint.config.js) — add rules there if needed.
testing_notes: No test framework is installed. If adding tests: install vitest (already works with Vite), add test scripts to package.json.
Priority test targets: validateStep() function (pure logic, easy to unit test), send-brief.ts handler (mock nodemailer).
localStorage behavior should be tested with jsdom (provided by vitest).
No E2E framework (Playwright, Cypress) is set up — if adding, configure to run against npm run dev:vercel for full-stack coverage.

risks.title: App.tsx monolith
risks.description: All 1665 lines of frontend code in one file. Every change risks breaking unrelated functionality. Hard to navigate, test, or onboard new contributors.
risks.recommendation: Extract step components into src/components/steps/, UI primitives into src/components/ui/, types into src/types/brief.ts, validation into src/lib/validation.ts.

risks.title: Hardcoded recipient email
risks.description: v.demidov@urc.org.ua is hardcoded in api/send-brief.ts. Changing it requires a code deploy.
risks.recommendation: Move to SMTP_TO env var. Add to .env.example.

risks.title: No API security
risks.description: POST /api/send-brief accepts any request with no authentication, CSRF protection, or rate limiting. Susceptible to email bombing.
risks.recommendation: Add a shared secret header check (simplest), or integrate Vercel's built-in rate limiting, or add a Turnstile/hCaptcha check.

risks.title: Uploaded files not included in email
risks.description: FileUpload stores images as base64 in React state. They are NOT sent to the server — only visible in local JSON/TXT downloads. User may not realize their reference images were not received.
risks.recommendation: Either send base64 data in the request body (risky for large files), upload to Vercel Blob/S3 separately and include URLs, or clearly inform the user in the UI.

risks.title: No localStorage schema versioning
risks.description: If BrandBrief type changes between deploys, a returning user with an old draft in localStorage will get corrupted state.
risks.recommendation: Add a BRIEF_SCHEMA_VERSION constant. On load, compare stored version — if mismatch, prompt user to clear draft or run a migration function.

risks.title: No test coverage
risks.description: Zero automated tests. Validation logic and email sending are manually verified only.
risks.recommendation: Add vitest for unit tests on validateStep() and send-brief.ts at minimum.

risks.title: Unused scaffolding assets
risks.description: src/assets/react.svg and src/assets/vite.svg are Vite template leftovers not used in the app.

recommended_next_steps.title: Move recipient to env var
recommended_next_steps.description: Replace hardcoded 'v.demidov@urc.org.ua' in api/send-brief.ts with process.env.SMTP_TO. Add to .env.example.

recommended_next_steps.title: Add basic API protection
recommended_next_steps.description: Add a simple shared secret: client reads VITE_API_SECRET env var and sends as X-Brief-Secret header. Server validates it. Prevents anonymous abuse.

recommended_next_steps.title: Add localStorage schema version
recommended_next_steps.description: Add SCHEMA_VERSION constant. Store with draft. On load, check — if mismatch, show banner asking user to reset or continue with possibly broken data.

recommended_next_steps.title: Extract types and validation out of App.tsx
recommended_next_steps.description: Create src/types/brief.ts (BrandBrief, Competitor types) and src/lib/validation.ts (validateStep). App.tsx imports them. No behavior change, enables testing.

recommended_next_steps.title: Extract step components
recommended_next_steps.description: Move each StepComponent into src/components/steps/CompanyBasicsStep.tsx etc. Move UI primitives into src/components/ui/. App.tsx becomes a thin orchestrator.

recommended_next_steps.title: Add unit tests for validateStep
recommended_next_steps.description: Install vitest. Write tests for each step validation case. No UI required — pure function tests.

recommended_next_steps.title: Handle uploaded reference images in email
recommended_next_steps.description: Include base64 images as inline attachments in the email, or add a Vercel Blob upload step before submission and include public URLs in the brief JSON.
